original.title: Higher cells before the penultimate column inject into earlier service rows
assumptions: Canonical positive-MEX/COPY recurrence and the named banked lemmas in the source.

exactAuditedStatement: For every q>=3, y=f(q, q-1), the higher earlier cells inject into source rows t<q with d(t)>y, hence #{c<q-1:f(q, c)>y}<=#{t<q:d(t)>y}.
hypotheses: q>=3 ensures y>=q+1; actual full journal, not a truncated history.
proofDependencyMap: Shared canonical foundation: exact positive-MEX/COPY recurrence and P01-P12, independently reconstructed in ../CANONICAL-FOUNDATIONS.md with exact declaration mapping and game interpretation. DEPENDENCIES.json records the additional service lemmas. Final kernel receipts bind the source versions.
independentDerivationAndChecks: A higher current cell is recomputed since its value>y>=q+1. The unique current y is later atq-1, so y is absent from the cell left prefix and MEX forces y in its journal.

P10 says y is not a past diagonal; it does not assert that y is a diagonal label. This excludes both inherited seeds and the source column birth diagonal. There is an actual private y award at a strict old column on some earlier row t<q. Row injectivity makes these t distinct between columns; strict row maximality gives d(t)>y.
This injection has capacity one and no record/tightness/density assumption. The finite q>=3 guard is retained rather than derived by an unproved penultimate live-floor extension.
